mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months, restrictive monetary policy increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and increase in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST declines and RSAFS increases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 5.0%), reduced consumer spending power from labor market weakness drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the UNRATE threshold condition falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong economic output growth, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) decline by more than 0.5% month-over-month for two consecutive months, weakening consumer demand causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in employment (PAYEMS) indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or the Rank IC for the interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During supply contraction regimes (INDPRO < 100.0), declining industrial production signals economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0, or the Rank IC for the INDPRO threshold condition falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
